plotTwists: {user} means to compliment {target} but accidentally says something so profound it becomes a server-wide inside joke.
{target} is so touched they immediately compliment {user} back, and it turns into a full compliment chain.
A stray cat sits down to listen, visibly moved by the sincerity.
The compliment is so wholesome that three random NPCs stop to say 'aww' in unison.
{user} gets so nervous mid-compliment they trip over their words, and it somehow makes it even sweeter.
The Whisper Merchant appears, genuinely touched, and gives {target} a free item out of pure emotion.
Time loops back and the compliment happens twice, and it's just as sincere both times.
